title: BattleTanx Studio launch request, version 1
description: Written once, as UTF-8 JSON, to the runtime's standard input when Studio starts it with the argument '--btga-launch-request -'. Never written to disk or into a project. Reference validator: tools/btga_studio/core/runtime.py validate_request.

session_id.description: Random per launch; the runtime should tag its logs and captures with it.

path.description: Absolute path of the .btgapkg Studio exported.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the package bytes; the runtime must refuse a mismatch.

scenario.description: Scenario key in project.json scenarios, or null for free play.

player_spawn.description: Record ID of a player_spawn / team_start record, or null for the runtime's choice.

bot_slots.description: AI slots (bot_slot records' ai_slot) to populate.

directory.description: Absolute directory for captures; required unless mode is none.

path.description: Absolute path of the user's cartridge, from Studio's local settings only.

features.description: Every runtime feature the package content uses (docs/RUNTIME_FEATURES.md).
